name: Global median luminance
definition: Median luminance within the target-cell mask.
calculation: Median Y over pixels inside the target-cell mask, without exterior-reference subtraction.

name: Fourier spectral centroid
definition: Typical spatial frequency of whole-cell power.
calculation: Power-weighted normalized radial frequency after cosine apodization inside the mask.

name: Radial luminance allocation
calculation: Median Y in each of 12 normalized-radius rings, centered by the cell median.

name: Radial frequency allocation
definition: Radial allocation of three frequency bands.
calculation: Within each of 12 rings, mean-square energy of low, mid, and high components.

name: Radial chromatic profile
definition: Radial allocation of the two opponent-color components.
calculation: For each of six normalized-radius rings, median opponent-color a and median b.

name: Boundary-depth luminance allocation
definition: Luminance allocation by distance inward from the boundary.
calculation: Median Y in each of 12 inward boundary-depth layers, centered by the cell median.

name: Boundary-depth frequency allocation
definition: Depth allocation of normalized frequency-band energy.
calculation: Layer mean squared band amplitude divided by whole-cell band energy, for 12 depth layers and three bands.

name: Boundary-depth chroma allocation
definition: Depth allocation of the two opponent-color components.
calculation: For each of 12 guarded boundary-depth layers, median opponent-color a and median b.

name: Boundary-interior optical contrast
definition: Luminance contrast between the inner rim and interior.
calculation: Mean Y within 5 px of the inner mask boundary minus mean Y in the remaining interior.

name: Gradient magnitude profile
definition: Spatial allocation of luminance edge strength.
calculation: Twelve-ring median profile of gradient magnitude after mask-normalized Gaussian smoothing.

name: Interface chromatic-gradient energy
definition: Strength of opponent-color transitions at the interface.
calculation: Mean squared gradient magnitude of a and of b in the inner interface band after mask-normalized Gaussian smoothing, sigma=max(0.02 D_eq,1.25 px).

name: Angular luminance heterogeneity
definition: Angular variation beyond a radial luminance baseline.
calculation: Twelve angular-sector medians of the absolute residual from a 12-ring radial median baseline.

name: Fourier orientation anisotropy
calculation: Normalized Fourier power across 12 angular bins after cosine apodization.

name: Radial-angular chromatic anisotropy
definition: Angular variation of color within radial rings.
calculation: For each of six rings, variance across available medians from 12 angular sectors.
